This is critical since billed ROs directly impact revenue. **Next step**: Aim to convert hours into ROs by prioritizing open jobs from the shared queue.

- You have not billed any ROs in the last three weeks, which is concerning. This could indicate a need for better time management or prioritization of tasks. **Next step**: Focus on completing jobs in the queue to convert your hours into billed work.

## Action Items for This Week
1. Pick up RO 777988 (CHECK ENGINE LIGHT) first thing on Monday to ensure timely service.
2. Aim to complete at least two ROs this week to convert your hours into billed work; monitor your progress daily.
